title: BCIAUT-P300 dataset for autism from Simoes et al 2020
description: A multi-session P300 brain-computer interface dataset comprising EEG recordings from 15 male individuals with autism spectrum disorder across 7 sessions. The dataset was collected during a joint-attention training task in a virtual environment using 8-channel EEG with visual feedback. This benchmark dataset supports the development and evaluation of P300-based BCI classifiers for clinical applications in autism research.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired at 250 Hz sampling rate using a g.Nautilus wireless system (g.tec) with 8 channels (C3, Cz, C4, CPz, P3, Pz, P4, POz) referenced to the right ear and grounded at AFz. The P300 paradigm involved visual presentation of 8 flashing objects with target and non-target stimuli. Each session included 2 runs with 1600 training trials and 400-4000 test trials. Data were preprocessed and bandpass filtered between 2.0 and 30.0 Hz.
